set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=5d3977850e10ee9399a1c0aacdbcbac4c1a30139; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; TARGET=RFCT70L7E8J; test "$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" get-state)" = device; PID="$("$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$PID"; echo PID=$PID; echo '--- ACTIVITY ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true; echo '--- WEBVIEW SOCKETS ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell cat /proc/net/unix | grep webview_devtools_remote || true; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_${PID}; sleep 1; echo '--- DEVTOOLS TARGETS ---'; JSON="$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json || true)"; printf '%s\n' "$JSON"; if [ -n "$JSON" ]; then python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess, sys, urllib.request
raw = subprocess.check_output(['curl','-fsS','http://127.0.0.1:9222/json'], text=True)
targets=json.loads(raw)
print('TARGET_COUNT='+str(len(targets)))
for i,t in enumerate(targets):
    print(f'TARGET_{i}_URL={t.get("url","")}')
    print(f'TARGET_{i}_TITLE={t.get("title","")}')
PY
fi; echo '--- UI DUMP ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/lcl-ui.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" shell cat /sdcard/lcl-ui.xml | head -c 20000 || true; echo; echo '--- APP ERRORS ---'; "$ADB" -s "$TARGET" logcat -d --pid="$PID" -v brief '*:E' | tail -80 || true
